ValidationRule.description: when an opportunity goes to closed won, the closed date must equal the first payment date
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: And( RecordTypeId = "0121a000000EqqS", OR( ISBLANK(Account.First_Payment_Date__c ), DATEVALUE(Account.First_Payment_Date__c) <> CloseDate ), ISPICKVAL( StageName , "Closed Won"), RecordTypeId <> "0121a000000RMUC", NOT(OR(ISPICKVAL(Existing_Business__c, "Home Leads"),ISPICKVAL(Existing_Business__c, "Upgrade - Key Account"),ISPICKVAL(Existing_Business__c, "Life Leads"), ISPICKVAL(Existing_Business__c, "Same Location - Different Lead Types")) ))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Closed Date on "Closed Won" Opportunity must equal first payment date
